root_cause_criterion.criterion: At the final line-1261 `compact_list(main_run_list)` merge guard, `RL_ISOLATE_LEVEL (list->prev) == RL_ISOLATE_LEVEL (list)` must hold before `merge_with_prev(list)` may execute. The stock vulnerable PoC violates that conjunct on the `newline`/`post_ltr` pair (`1 == 0` false) and still reaches the sink; the fixed stock PoC is guarded there, while the adjacent `fsi_to_tail_ltr` witness executes the same protected sink with `0 == 0` true.
root_cause_criterion.description: The missing source-level obligation is the isolate-level equality check on the final `compact_list()` merge predicate. That guard is the only missing conjunct between the already-matching type/level/bracket tests and the crashing `merge_with_prev(post_ltr)` call.

nodes.state: At the first line-1261 merge, the final tail run still holds `second->next->next->prev_isolate == second` immediately before `fribidi_free(second)`, so the code is about to free a run that remains linked from the surviving tail.
In the crashing final tail merge, `second->prev_isolate` is the exact run pointer freed by the first line-1261 merge, so line 93 writes through a dangling isolate-link pointer.

edges.relation: The same final tail run selected by the rooted `compact_list()` predicate is passed unchanged as `second` into the later `merge_with_prev()` sink.
The exact run pointer freed by the first line-1261 merge later reappears as `second->prev_isolate` at the crashing final merge, establishing the free-before-use reuse.
